summary.text: Dawn Creekmore is the Republican candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 92 in the November 3, 2026 general election; no other candidate is listed for the seat.
She previously served in the Arkansas House representing District 27 from 2005 to 2011.

paragraphs.text: Dawn Creekmore, listed by Ballotpedia as a Democrat during her earlier service, assumed office in the Arkansas House of Representatives representing District 27 in 2005 and left office in 2011.
She chaired the House Aging, Children and Youth, Legislative and Military Affairs Committee and served on the Judiciary Committee.

Creekmore was ineligible to run for re-election in 2010 because of House term limits, so she ran for Arkansas State Senate District 22 instead, winning the Democratic primary but losing the general election to Jeremy Hutchinson.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner.
In the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 92 she defeated Eric Shepherd with 54.7 percent of the vote.
